messages:
Alex: Quick check — RFC review on Wed. Need to lock the slot roster and call out a standby reviewer in case someone drops. Who can present runtime-optimizations RFC?
Maya: I can present but only after 11:00 PT. otherwise +1 to standby flow.
Jonah: Can do 10:00–10:45 PT. If you need later, I can be backup reviewer for the runtime part.
Sara: I can review but heads-up: client sync may run long Wed. happy to be standby and take notes + action items. :memo:
Alex: OK — looks like two windows. Plan: 10:00 PT primary block, 11:30 PT secondary. Prefer 10:00 for authors to avoid late day churn.
Maya: 10:00 doesn't work for me. If author prefers morning, I'll be standby and handoff presenter duties to Jonah.
Jonah: I'm happy to present runtime at 10:00. Maya, can you do pre-read + highlight quantization checks?
Maya: Yep — I'll drop comments in the doc by EOD Tue. Doc: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/runtime-quantization
Alex: Agenda proposal:
```
- 10:00 - quick context (5m)
- 10:05 - author walkthrough (15m)
- 10:20 - focused QA: perf/latency/kv-cache (15m)
- 10:35 - rollouts & fallback policy (10m)
- 10:45 - action items + follow-ups (5m)
```
Sara: Can we timebox the rollout discussion to 10m? We had long tangents last time. :hourglass:
messages_continued:
Alex: Agreed — strict timeboxing. Also adding a standby roster: if presenter drops, reviewer steps in to present + owner takes notes. Standby list: Jonah, Sara, Maya (in that order).
calendar-bot: Meeting created: Wed 10:00 PT — "RFC: runtime-optimizations" — link to calendar invite.
Maya: I'll leave a short TL;DR at top of the doc for folks who only skim.
Jonah: @Alex can you add the canary metrics snippet to the agenda? it's a quick check but important for rollouts.
Alex: Added: canary metrics (5m) under rollouts.
Sara: Last ask — please react with :eyes: on the doc when you've done pre-read. I'll collate comments before the meeting.
Alex: Cool. Action items:
- Maya: pre-read comments by EOD Tue (:eyes:)
- Jonah: present runtime at 10:00 PT
- Sara: standby + collate comments
- Alex: finalize calendar + agenda order, add canary metrics note
Everyone: please update availability if anything changes — we'll shift to 11:30 PT if >1 conflict.
Jonah: Got it. I can swap if needed.
Maya: Ping me Tues morning if you need me to present instead.
Alex: Thanks all :thumbsup:
